description: This file contains utility methods for camera operations in an Android application, including selecting optimal video sizes, accessing default cameras, and creating media files.

classes.name: CameraHelper
classes.description: Utility class providing camera-related operations such as retrieving available cameras, selecting optimal video sizes, and creating media files.

methods.name: getOptimalVideoSize
methods.description: Selects the best matching video size supported by the camera based on the view dimensions and aspect ratio.

methods.name: getDefaultCamera
methods.description: Private method to retrieve a camera based on its position (front or back).

methods.name: getOutputMediaFile
methods.description: Creates and returns a media file in the external pictures directory, with filename timestamp.
